text:
Multiracial students made up 4.3% of Parsons Elementary's enrollment in 2024-25
Eighteen students at Parsons Elementary School were identified as multiracial in the 2024-25 school year, a decrease of 18.2% from the previous year, according to the Michigan Department of Education.
Parsons Elementary enrolled 418 students during the 2024-25 school year. Multiracial students accounted for 4.3% of the enrollment, the third-largest ethnic group at the school. White students were the largest group, making up 83% (347) of the student body.
The school is part of Gibraltar School District, whose central office is in Rockwood.
Among Gibraltar School District's seven schools, Oscar A. Carlson High School had the highest enrollment of multiracial students in the 2024-25 school year.
Michigan’s 2026 education budget totals $24.1 billion, including $19.5 billion from the School Aid Fund. Per-pupil funding was set at $10,050, a 4.6% increase from the previous year. The budget maintained free school meals and included full funding for pre-K and community college.
